mainImage.alt: Aerial photograph of the Boardman Coal Plant showing the main power station building with its tall smokestack, surrounded by agricultural land near the Columbia River in eastern Oregon.
mainImage.caption: The Boardman Coal Plant operated by Portland General Electric, photographed at Carty Reservoir. The 440-megawatt plant was Oregon's only coal-fired power plant and its single largest source of greenhouse gas pollution from 1980 until its closure in 2020.

body.alt: Explosive demolition of the Boardman coal plant smokestack showing a massive plume of dust and debris as the 656-foot tower collapses in September 2022.
body.caption: Explosive demolition of the Boardman coal plant's 656-foot smokestack in September 2022. The controlled detonation marked the physical end of Oregon's coal-fired power generation era.

body.alt: An Amazon Web Services data center facility in Boardman, Oregon, showing large industrial buildings in the rural landscape of Morrow County.
Aerial view of Amazon data center construction near Boardman, Oregon in February 2026 showing massive warehouse buildings and surrounding farmland.
body.caption: An aerial view of an Amazon data center construction site near Boardman, Oregon in February 2026. One of ten Amazon campuses in Morrow County.
